owner_request: Account for time and rotation relative to a plane; warp clock and shift layers; check overall length.
input: Committed ac00009 original112 and new78 move arrays frozen in previous counter-test inputs.json; no newly generated routes.
clock: One shared tick per paid official move; per-relator update tick counts are recorded separately, not averaged. Chart uses fixed target-centered frames X^-1 rho(r0),Y^-1 rho(r1).
H0: Both state paths differ only by monotone endpoint-preserving re-timing and repetitions of identical observations; clock-only alignment succeeds iff exact state sequences agree after consecutive duplicate removal.
H1: Separate layer clocks explain differences even if full-state clock alignment fails; test equality of each relator's ordered update sequence after removal of consecutive duplicates. No permutation of layers or free move reordering.
rotation: Compare exact disk coordinates in fixed frames; record principal angle increments for nonzero successive points. These are sampled coordinate angles, not a proven continuous winding or physical rotation rate. Nonzero shared start fixes any constant plane rotation preserving that start to identity.
lengths: Record paid move count, peak total relator length, terminal total length and cumulative pre-move word length separately. Retiming cannot change paid move count.
coverage: Exact longest common subsequence of whole states supplies monotone shared anchors and paid interval-length differences; no interpolation or approximate geometric matches.
decision: If either layer's reduced exact trajectory differs, pure layer-clock alignment is insufficient for these two routes. It may still provide a useful diagnostic; do not infer a general impossibility or reject the owner's broader hypothesis.
claims: Read-only route comparison; UPGH owns fresh search on ac00009/ac00028. No claim, route search, submission or old recipe import.
